subject: vitest
claim: Vitest 5 no longer looks for a config file in parent directories, so run it from the folder that has the config or pass --config.

source.quote: Don't lookup config file from ancestor directories

subject: vitest
claim: Vitest 5 removed the WebdriverIO browser provider package, so browser mode can no longer use WebdriverIO as its provider.

subject: vitest
claim: In Vitest 5, toHaveTextContent matches an element's text strictly; use the new toMatchTextContent for a partial match.

source.quote: toHaveTextContent is strict, add toMatchTextContent as alternative

subject: vitest
claim: In Vitest 5, the blob reporter writes to .vitest/blob/ by default, and --merge-reports reads from .vitest/blob/ by default.

subject: vitest
claim: In Vitest 5 browser mode, locators match text exactly by default (locators.exact is true), so a partial text match no longer finds the element.

subject: vitest
claim: In Vitest 5, the name that -t (testNamePattern) matches joins nested describe and test names with > instead of spaces.

subject: vitest
claim: In Vitest 5, inline projects in test.projects inherit the root config by default, without extends: true.

source.quote: Inline projects extend the root config by default

subject: vitest
claim: Vitest 5 throws an error when vi.mock or another hoisted method is called outside the module's top level, for example inside a function or a hook.

source.quote: Throw an error if hoistable methods are outside the top level scope

subject: vitest
claim: Vitest 5 adds `vi.when()` for mocks that return different results depending on the arguments they are called with.

subject: vitest
claim: In Vitest 5, vitest list collects tests by parsing the files statically by default, instead of running them.

source.quote: Parse files statically in vitest list by default
